name: chess
description: Play chess against Claude (or Jev, when a Jev key is set) in a side pane while you work. Click a piece and a square, or type a move; Claude answers through a fork of the session, Jev through TypeSafe's decision API, and the pane shows the tokens each move cost as the API reported them, and the running total. Docked beside the transcript in the fullscreen layout, above the prompt otherwise. Needs function hooks (early access).

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (30-100); a width you drag it to wins

pieces.title: Pieces
pieces.description: How pieces are drawn: unicode glyphs or FEN letters (uppercase White)

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model for a move Claude makes before the session's first turn, when there is no transcript to fork

board.title: Board colors
board.description: Which side's pieces are drawn solid: 'theme' follows the Claude Code theme (auto counts as dark); set 'light' or 'dark' when an auto theme resolves the other way

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Jev key for TypeSafe's own API; when set, Jev plays instead of Claude

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Jev key for the AI Gateway; when set (and no TypeSafe key), Jev plays instead of Claude

provider.title: Opponent backend
provider.description: "auto" plays Jev on TypeSafe when its key is set, then on the Gateway, else Claude; "claude" always plays Claude

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev's move before playing a random legal move for it
